landing.heroTitle: The anonymous way to be reachable when your car needs you.
landing.heroSubtitle: A QR sticker on the windshield. We alert you instantly, without ever revealing your number.
landing.problemsTitle: Every day, drivers face these problems
landing.problemsSubtitle: A small issue can become a big headache when you can't reach the owner. CarLink makes it simple.
landing.problem1Text: Someone parked in your spot or blocked your exit? With CarLink, they can be notified in seconds.
landing.problem2Text: A dent, a scratch, an accident? Witnesses can instantly contact you with details.
landing.problem3Text: Your headlights are still on and your battery is draining. A passerby can alert you before it's too late.
landing.problem4Text: Rain is coming or theft risk is high. Someone can warn you immediately.
landing.problem5Text: Interested in buying the car? Leave your contact instantly — no need to leave a paper note.
landing.problem6Text: Charging station occupied and you need to charge? Contact the owner to estimate their return.
landing.problemsCtaText: Don't let small issues become big problems.
landing.howSubtitle: Three simple steps to protect your vehicle and stay connected. No app to download, no complicated setup.
landing.how1Title: Stick the QR on your car
landing.how1Text: Print your QR code and stick it on your vehicle's windshield.
landing.how2Text: They scan the QR with their phone, choose WhatsApp or SMS, and send a message — without ever seeing your number.
landing.how3Text: The message arrives in your CarLink space. Reply directly via WhatsApp or SMS.
landing.howTrustText: Your visitors don't need to install anything. They just scan and send.
landing.advTitle: The smart advantage of being reachable
landing.advSubtitle: More than a QR code — a complete, private and instant way to stay in touch with your car.
landing.adv1Text: Your phone number is never revealed. You stay 100% anonymous to every visitor.
landing.adv2Text: Get notified in real-time the moment someone contacts you about your vehicle.
landing.adv3Text: Anyone can scan and send a message. No download, no sign-up — it just works.
landing.adv4Text: Receive messages on your favourite channel and reply directly from it.
landing.adv5Text: Protect all your cars with a single account and a QR code per vehicle.
landing.adv6Text: Regenerate or deactivate a QR code anytime — your contact stays in your hands.
landing.reachTitle: We reach you in more than one way
landing.reachSubtitle: Receive alerts by SMS message or an anonymous alert call, depending on your plan. SMS uses mobile signal; the anonymous call needs an internet connection.
landing.reachSmsText: The warning reaches you as a direct text message.
landing.reachCallText: The warning reaches you as an anonymous call, so the caller's number stays hidden.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about CarLink. Can't find your answer? Contact us.
landing.faq1A: Someone scans the QR code on your vehicle and sends you a message. You instantly receive an alert by SMS or anonymous call — no personal data is ever shared.
landing.faq2Q: Do I need to install an app?
landing.faq2A: No. CarLink works entirely in your browser. Visitors just scan the QR and type their message; you manage everything from your dashboard.
landing.faq3Q: Is my phone number visible to visitors?
landing.faq3A: Never. Your number and personal details stay completely hidden. Every message is routed through CarLink without revealing your identity.
landing.faq4A: Plans start at 20 TND for a single vehicle, with packages for multiple vehicles and businesses. See the Pricing page for details.
landing.faq5Q: Can I regenerate or deactivate my QR code?
landing.faq5A: Yes, anytime. You keep full control of your QR codes and can regenerate or deactivate them directly from your dashboard.
landing.legalPrivacySection1Text: We collect only the private data needed to operate CarLink: your account details, your vehicle information, and the QR code for your sticker.
landing.legalPrivacySection2Text: All communications between you and CarLink are encrypted. Your phone number and personal details are never exposed publicly and never stored in a readable format.
landing.legalPrivacySection3Text: We never sell or rent your personal data. The only party that sees your contact details is you — CarLink relays messages to you anonymously.
landing.legalPrivacySection4Text: You can access, correct, export, or delete your personal data at any time from your dashboard settings.
landing.legalPrivacySection5Text: If you have any question about this policy, reach us through the contact page and we will answer quickly.
landing.legalTermsSection1Text: By using CarLink, you agree to these terms of use. If you do not agree, please do not use our service.
landing.legalTermsSection2Text: CarLink provides an anonymous QR-based contact system between vehicle owners and passers-by. The purchase of a sticker grants access to the corresponding QR code and its message relay.
landing.legalTermsSection3Text: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for the security of your account. You must not use the service for any illegal or abusive purpose.
landing.legalTermsSection4Text: CarLink delivers the QR service as-is. We are not liable for any indirect or incidental damages related to the use of the service.
landing.legalTermsSection5Text: We may update these terms from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page.
landing.legalCommsSection1Text: We only send you communications you have chosen: contact alerts, notifications from your dashboard, and important updates about the service.
landing.legalCommsSection2Text: Alerts can be delivered by SMS (using mobile signal) or by WhatsApp / anonymous alert call (requiring an internet connection), depending on your plan and your settings.
landing.legalCommsSection3Text: Any promotional or non-essential communication is sent only with your explicit consent, and you can opt out at any time.
landing.legalCommsSection4Text: We never share your phone number or contact details with third parties. Your information is used only to deliver messages to you.
landing.legalCommsSection5Text: To manage your preferences or ask a question about this policy, contact us through the contact page.
landing.review1Text: I had my lights on all night in a parking lot. Thanks to CarLink, someone scanned the QR and sent me a WhatsApp message. I saved my battery!
landing.review2Text: Simple, fast, and anonymous. I don't have to leave my number on a piece of paper anymore. Much better for privacy.
landing.review3Text: I'm an EV driver. When someone takes my charging spot, I get a notification instantly. Really useful!
landing.review4Text: A passer-by saw my window open during rain and alerted me through CarLink. The QR is easy to set up and works perfectly.
landing.review5Text: I wanted to buy a parked car but didn't want to leave a note. I scanned the QR, sent a message, and got a reply within minutes.
landing.review6Text: My car was blocked in a tight spot. CarLink helped the owner find me quickly. No app needed, just scan and send.
landing.finalSectionTitle: One purchase. Your sticker never expires.
landing.finalSectionSubtitle: A QR sticker for your vehicle — let anyone contact you instantly while staying 100% anonymous. No app, no fuss.
landing.pricingSubtitle: One-time purchase. No subscription, no hidden fees. Your sticker never expires.
landing.pricingPack2Subtitle: For you and a loved one
landing.pricingPack3Subtitle: 20 stickers for your fleet or company
landing.pricingFeature5: No app download required for visitors

about.heroTitle: A small sticker that connects drivers, honestly.
about.heroSubtitle: CarLink was born from a simple frustration: not being able to reach a driver when you need to — or not wanting to reveal your number when someone reaches you. We build tools that keep you contactable without giving up your privacy.
about.originText1: One evening, a driver found their car blocked by another vehicle. No owner in sight, no way to call them, and no paper note — just hours of waiting. That night, the question was simple: what if a parked car could tell you how to reach its owner without revealing their number?
about.originText2: We set out to build exactly that: a QR sticker, a private relay, and instant alerts. No app to install, no personal data exposed, no subscription — just a smarter way to be reachable when your car needs it.
about.valuesSubtitle: Four principles guide every decision we make.
about.value1Text: Your phone number and personal data are never shared. Anonymity is a feature, not an afterthought.
about.value2Text: No app to download, no complicated setup. If it takes more than 30 seconds, we haven't finished our job.
about.value3Text: One-time pricing, no hidden fees, no forced subscriptions. What we promise is what you get.
about.value4Text: Every driver who helps another keeps our roads — and our shared spaces — kinder.
